title: GridSim groups document (gridsim-groups/1)
description: RC4 R4-01. A sidecar that groups the elements of one case (areas, zones, owners, feeders, free groups). It is bound to the case by the bundle SHA-256 that every study verb takes, and is never stored in the case itself. Members are named by stable identity: a bus by ID, a generator by index into the whole fleet plus its expected bus, a branch by index plus its expected from and to bus IDs. Area, zone and owner are exclusive kinds: one element belongs to at most one group of each. A feeder is ordered and has a head. The GridSim reader is strict and refuses unknown or duplicated members; this schema describes the shape, the reader enforces identity and exclusivity against the case.

sha256.description: The master bundle digest (consumed-file lines: path, TAB, file SHA-256, LF, in load order).

head.description: Feeder only: the head element, which must be one of the group's members.
